title: Username is required
why: Shows that a username cannot be skipped even when the email and password are fine.

steps.does: POST …/identity/register-user with UserName '' (empty). FirstName Anna, LastName Meyer, Email anna.meyer@example.com, PassPortNumber DE9876543, Password Str0ng!Pass1, matching ConfirmPassword.

expect: Rejected with a validation error naming UserName as required. No User row is created.
